Source contracts: scripts/binary_snapshot.py

scripts/binary_snapshot.py

Python · Tier B

Copy an allowlisted tracked source snapshot and record provenance.

Usage

snapshot prepares build input; clean_build_debris removes staged development debris.

Inputs

Git checkout, destination and explicit path/suffix allowlists.

Side effects

Reads Git tracked paths and revision/dirty state; rejects links/private-key material, copies allowed source and hashes it. Never walks arbitrary runtime directories.

Cleanup

Debris cleanup affects the supplied staged tree; the caller owns snapshot lifetime.

@see scripts/binary_runtime_image.py

@see docs/binary-distribution.md
